x: Although beaten in the 220 yards by Marsh of Hercules, Gerry ran a fine 'quarter' to edge out Sunstan (S.L.H.) in 50.9 to show that he is still a force to be reckoned with over one lap.
Poly had three internationals in Campbell, Frith and Cheskin - LAC had Winbolt-Lewis and Marsh - and running in "claret and gold" were John Mitchell and Chris Martin.
